name: sprite-gen
title_zh: 组件行流水线出精灵图集，带 QA 报告和运行时清单
tagline_zh: 一句话出一套干净的 2D 游戏精灵图：状态行排布、透明底、逐帧拆分、运行时图集，产物直接丢进游戏引擎就能用。
tagline_en: One line, one clean sprite sheet — state rows, alpha cleanup, frame extraction and runtime atlases, ready to drop straight into your engine.
desc_en: Generate clean 2D game sprites and animation atlases with a component-row pipeline: base identity, numeric sprite-request SSoT, per-state layout guides, image-gen row strips, chroma-key alpha cleanup, connected-component frame extraction, cell-based atlas composition, QA reports, and runtime manifest frame_layout. Its curation webview also serves ANY image-candidate set (icons, logos, generated dr
why_zh: 游戏素材是独立开发最大的坑之一，它把「画小人」变成了一句话的事，产物直接进引擎。
why_en: Art is indie dev's biggest wall; this turns "draw me a sprite" into a one-liner with engine-ready output.
limit_zh: 生成那步要本机装好 codex 或 grok CLI 并登录。脚本只认仓库自建的 .venv，缺 NumPy 就在 import 处硬报错——作者明写没有纯 Python 降级。正文大半是韩文。
limit_en: Generation shells out to the codex or grok CLI with their OAuth logins. Scripts run only from the repo's own .venv; the entry point hard-errors without NumPy and the text states there is no pure-Python fallback. Much of the doc is Korean.
